posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
So, this seems like a good place to post a list of everything I can confirm us getting, because it is making my head explode.

 

Base 5 heroes: Luminary, Harpy, Akash'Thriya, La Commadora, and Lifeline (previously Baron Blade, The Matriarch, Akash'Bhuta, La Capitan, and Deadline respectively)

6 stretch goal heroes: Stuntman, Benchmark, and the 4 Void Guard (Previously known as Ambuscade, {Revenant?} Writhe, Mainstay, Idealist and Dr. Medico respectively)

18 new variants: Omnitron-U, Parse (Fugue State), Extremist Sky-scraper, Visionary Unleashed, Captain Cosmic (Vengeance? Whispers of OblivAeon?), Completionist Guise, Luminary (Genderbent? Hero of the People?), Darkwatch Harpy, Stuntman (Ramboscade), Supply and Demand Benchmark, Akash'Thriya Spirit of the Void, La Comodora Curse of the Black Spot, Lifeline Bloodmage, the Five 90's Xtreme Prime Wardens (Argent Adept, Fanatic, Captain Cosmic, Haka, and Tempest)

There are an Unknown number of Environments in the Base, but we do know that Fort Adamant and The Nexus of the Void have been added, so 2 there and I'll assume at least 1 environement in the base.

"Several Villain Decks" according to the page in the Base. 2 Will be OblivAeon and the Aeon Men. Scions will make up the rest. I feel a minimum of 3 Scions, but if we use Progeny's deck as a reference we'll end up with 4 Scions (Flame, Blight, Storm and Frost)

 

So... staring at a minimum of 19 new decks with 18 variant cards coming down the pipe. And likely more than that. If we assume 3 environments base and 4 scion decks... 22 new decks of Sentinels goodness.

 

Oh and this is ignoring the Mission Deck since we have no idea how it will even work or effect the game.
